title: FUNDAMENTAL LIMITATIONS OF ALIGNMENT IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the conditional KL-divergence and expected behavior scoring of model outputs when subjected to adversarial misaligning prompts sampled from a negative component fine-tuned on anti-immigration statements.

Training SVM classifiers on the model's last token representations to analyze the spatial separation and distinguishability of specific political stances (e.g., beliefs on abortion and gun rights) in the latent space.
